About ELDORADO

A dealership built on clarity.

ELDORADO exists to make buying a premium automobile in Nigeria straightforward: well-chosen vehicles, honest details and a team that answers.

Our approach

Fewer cars, better chosen.

We would rather show a focused collection than a long list. Every vehicle is presented with the details a buyer needs: year, mileage, condition and price in Naira.

Selection

Sedans and SUVs from Mercedes-Benz, Range Rover, Lexus, Toyota and BMW, new and foreign used.

Transparency

Clear listings, plain answers and no pressure. If a detail is not on the page, ask us.

Service

Test drives by appointment, vehicle swaps considered and a person on the other end of WhatsApp.

What we offer

Four ways to arrive.

  1. Brand-new vehiclesCurrent-year models, delivered with delivery mileage only.
  2. Foreign-used vehiclesLow-mileage, carefully selected vehicles, often called tokunbo.
  3. Vehicle swapsBring the vehicle you own. Valuation is subject to dealership assessment.
  4. Test drivesChoose a day and a time window. We confirm by WhatsApp or phone.
